gloss: apt to; tending to; all too easily

definitions.gloss: apt to; tending to; liable to; all too easily
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something undesirable tends to happen or that a situation easily drifts in a negative direction. Used to warn about natural but unwanted tendencies.

examples.japanese: ともすれば⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧がち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: One tends to forget all too easily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧はともすれば⟦{感情的|かんじょうてき}→感情的：05678_kanjouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Discussions are apt to become emotional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{追|お}い{求|もと}める⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、ともすれば⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧なもの⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見失|みうしな}い→見失う：14129_miushinau⟧がちだ。
examples.english: When pursuing efficiency, one all too easily tends to lose sight of what's important.

notes:
A somewhat literary adverb that signals an undesirable tendency. Always points to something negative or problematic that naturally tends to occur. The variant とも⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ has the same meaning.

USAGE:
Appears at the beginning or middle of a sentence. Almost always followed by a negative tendency — something undesirable that happens if one is not careful. Common in essays, commentary, and formal speech. Often paired with がち (tending to) or やすい (easy to).

FORMS:
- とも⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ — same meaning, slightly more colloquial
- ⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧ — similar meaning, more literary
- ⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ — similar meaning

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ともすれば〜がちだ — tend to (negative)
- ともすれば〜⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい — liable to become
- ともすれば⟦{見落|みお}とし→見落とす：04578_miotosu⟧がちな — apt to overlook

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦やや→やや：03642_yaya⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧ — tending to (more literary)
- つい — unintentionally, inadvertently (more casual)
- {得|え}てして — apt to, tending to (written style)
